image_description: A close-up portrait of a Blue Monkey (Cercopithecus mitis), a species of guenon, perched on a tree branch. The monkey has dark fur on its back and limbs, a white chest ruff, and a distinctive greyish-blue face with a narrow nose. It is looking downwards to the left. The background is a soft-focus green foliage.

The nose bridge is narrow and elongated, typical of Cercopithecidae.
Ears are small and partially obscured by the head fur/ruff, but visible structure is correct.
